basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software developer from Portland, Oregon. I have a passion for curly hair care and spend a lot of time on the curlyhair subreddit sharing tips and tricks. I'm also an avid gamer, particularly interested in Nintendo Switch and games like Animal Crossing and Dragon Quest Builders. I enjoy trading and discussing Magic: The Gathering cards. I work remotely, which allows me to be online during irregular hours, often late into the night. I'm currently single and love exploring new hobbies, especially those that can be enjoyed indoors.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been programming professionally for over a decade. My knowledge in hair care comes from years of personal experience and online research, as well as active participation in related communities. I also stay updated on gaming trends and MTG finance through community discussions and personal trading experiences.
